scope: Original ten photographs plus the MF8 BauhiniaMinx follow-up. Mechanism-pending models now have reference-only cards in their existing app families; they are not playable profiles.

models.name: AJ Curvy Dinominx 4×4
models.remaining: Two-depth 120-degree vertex turns, 26 panels per face, colour entry and independent state solver verified. Android device performance and physical unit comparison remain untested. Earlier unverified partial-turn jumbling requirement corrected after checking the supplier's bare-body, sticker-sheet and turned-state photographs.

models.name: VeryPuzzle Clover Dodecahedron
models.remaining: Offset axes, curved intersecting caps, partial turns and state-dependent gates, entry and solver. Not the previously requested spherical puzzle.

models.name: 向阳花 / LanLan Sunflower Cube
models.remaining: Edge-turning curved cuts, jumbling, bandaging gates, shape entry and solver.

models.name: 仙女座 / LanLan Andromeda
models.remaining: Interlocking curved cuts, physical axes and partial-turn gates, shape entry and solver.

models.name: 蝶恋花 / LanLan Butterflower
models.remaining: 用户确认120°为目测，按实际切线对齐：已接通J约70.529°及补角109.471°的换瓣、变形打乱、共享姿态录入、不可见材料补全、先复形后配色求解与回放。24组换瓣已逐步通过全部101材料区域的阻挡检查；30/100/300步共24例可见块重新录入均还原。任意复杂变形的复形搜索仍有时间限额；安卓与实物内轨尚未验收。

models.name: 十二轴双棱花 / LanLan Master Clover Cube
models.remaining: 常规双层180°模型、120片逐面录入、8个角部与中心连体块、独立大层小层、状态求解与回放已接通。新增半圆弧为照片重建，内部连续切面尚未测定；变形混转仍未接通，不能把常规回放当作实物混转认证。安卓真机待验。

models.name: 双鱼座 / LanLan Pisces (Pitcher 4-Corner)
models.remaining: Independent faceted 12-axis material, colour/pose entry, guarded turns, state solver, original lessons and two native viewport sizes verified. Physical curved shell/track comparison, human visual-entry usability and arbitrary hard-shape completeness remain unverified.

models.name: 花瓣魔方（魔花） / LanLan Flower Copter
models.remaining: User-supplied Drawing1.dwg determines all twelve face arcs and twenty panels per face. Regular edge180/corner120 turns, colour/pose input, independent state solving, playback, original lessons, save/restore and two native desktop viewport sizes are verified. Partial turns/jumbling, manufacturer internal tracks and Android device performance remain unverified.

models.name: 魔蝶 / LanLan Curvy Copter
models.remaining: Explicit spherical-profile model now has production colour/pose input, guarded turns, state solving, full playback, original lessons and session restoration. Native X/Y/Z pose controls were tested using measured synthetic observations, not human observation or physical hardware. Physical cut/track comparison, simpler visual shape matching and hard-shape completeness remain unverified; do not count as the full physical model being finished.

models.name: 永骏枫叶球 / YJ Yeet Ball
models.remaining: Android device performance and physical unit comparison have not been tested.

models.name: MF8 BauhiniaMinx / 紫荆五魔方（Rex Dodecahedron）
models.remaining: Standard aligned 120-degree geometry, colour entry and independent state solving are connected. Arbitrary jumbled-shape entry and hidden filler-piece blocking are still pending; this is not full physical-mechanism completion.
